meta.title: Work with partners instead of for a boss | 1lev1
meta.description: You do not have to choose between a boss and going it alone. Join a venture with partners, contribute your time and skills, and take a share of the profit in proportion to what you actually gave. You can start with a few hours a week.

hero.h1: You do not have to choose between a boss and going it alone
hero.sub: There is a path in between: join a venture with partners, contribute what you are good at, and take a share of the profit in proportion to what you actually contributed — without building the whole thing yourself, and without someone else deciding for you.
hero.risk: You do not have to quit. You can start with a few hours a week, alongside the job.
hero.ctaPrimary: Tell us what you are good at

next.title: What happens after you click
next.s1: A 20-minute conversation, no commitment. You tell us what you are good at and how much time you have.
next.s2: We look for a rikma that fits your skills and your schedule — or help you open one.
next.s3: From the first hour you log, your share of the profit starts accruing. Transparent, and agreed in advance.

doubts.title: What actually stops people
doubts.q1_q: How do I know I will not get taken advantage of?
doubts.q1_a: The split is not settled by argument but by a formula: the time and resources you contributed, logged and approved. And every decision that touches you goes through consent — there is no button in the system that rejects you outright.
doubts.q2_q: What if I work more than the others?
doubts.q2_a: Then your share is larger. That is exactly the difference from fifty-fifty: the split moves with actual contribution instead of staying stuck on whatever was agreed on day one.
doubts.q3_q: And if there is a dispute?
doubts.q3_a: Every claim stays open for the period the rikma set, and you answer it with a counter-proposal rather than a refusal. Both sides sign the same version, or the clock matures whatever is on the table.

close.title: Shall we start?
close.sub: No long forms and no credit card. Just a short conversation, after which you will know whether this fits you.
